name: Sanitary Ware & Second-Fix Fixtures (Bathroom, Kitchen, Accessories)

sequence.note: Sanitary fixtures mount onto finished, tanked, tiled surfaces; installing before finishes damages the tile plane and traps leaks.

activities: verify concealed water supply, drainage stub-outs and cistern carriers are set to fixture centrelines
confirm concealed valves / in-wall frames installed at first fix
sequence.note: Concealed carriers, cistern frames and pipe positions are a first-fix hold that must match the fixture setting-out; mismatch means re-tiling.

activities: set WCs, basins, baths, showers, urinals
fix mixers, spouts, shower valves, wastes and traps
install accessories, mirrors, grab/towel rails into blocking/tile fixings
sequence.note: Wall-hung WCs and grab rails require the concealed frame/blocking placed at first fix; anchors into tanked walls use sealed details.

activities: fit appliances (kitchen) and final electrical connections to fixtures
sequence.note: This is the architecture-MEP second-fix handshake: fixtures meet terminated, energised services.

activities: fill/drain and leak test at each fixture
sequence.note: Testing follows final connection; a fixture is only complete once its services are tested and commissioned; final sign-off cannot precede MEP testing.
Perimeter silicone is applied after fixtures are set and tested, completing the wet seal.

typical_relationships.before: tiling / wall finishes / waterproofing complete & signed
typical_relationships.reason: fixtures fix onto finished tanked/tiled surfaces; mounting first damages finishes and breaches the waterproofing envelope

typical_relationships.before: MEP first-fix carriers, valves & pipe positions set
typical_relationships.reason: wall-hung frames, concealed valves and supply/waste positions must match fixture centrelines fixed at first fix; a mismatch forces demolition of finished tile
pressure, leak, flush/disinfection and TMV commissioning happen after final connection; the fixture must be present to be tested
a fixture is only accepted once its services are tested; sealing and closing out before test hides leaks
counter basins and mixers seat into the vanity; the carcass must exist first

typical_relationships.after: grab rails / wall-hung WC / heavy accessories
typical_relationships.reason: load-bearing accessories need concealed structural fixing placed during wall build

interfaces.requirement: concealed cistern carriers/in-wall frames, supply and drainage stub-outs and concealed valves set to fixture centrelines before tiling - so second-fix fixtures land exactly (critical first-fix handshake)
fixtures connected to terminated services, then pressure/leak/flush/disinfection and TMV commissioning completed and signed before final acceptance (final fixtures after MEP testing done)
anchors and penetrations into tanked wet-area substrates use approved sealed details; membrane integrity preserved around fixtures
tiling complete and set-out to fixture centrelines before mounting; cuts around wastes/valves finished
cabinetry and worktops set before counter basins, sinks, taps and appliance final connect

commissioning_dependencies: drainage leak/flow test at each fixture
testing_requirements: flow rate and temperature / TMV setting
grab-rail / wall-hung WC load / pull test
typical_exceptions: prefabricated bathroom pods arrive with sanitaryware pre-fitted and pre-tested - site scope becomes riser connection only
concealed-cistern (in-wall) systems shift more work to first fix than close-coupled WCs
touchless/smart fixtures add electrical and controls second-fix and commissioning
commercial washroom IPS/duct panels integrate carriers and access panels, widening the MEP interface
evidence: Sanitary fixtures are the terminal second-fix finishing trade, bracketed by two hard MEP gates: first-fix carriers/positions set to centrelines before tiling, and pressure/flush/TMV commissioning before final acceptance. Fixtures-onto-finished-tanked-surface and load-bearing-accessory blocking are universals. Generalized across residential and commercial washrooms; no project-specific data.
